about.description:
The Art Finishing & Graphic Production course was created for designers and production artists who want to master technical pre-press and transform creative concepts into flawless manufactured products.

We combine preflight inspection, color management, pagination, offset and digital presses, and automated workflows using PitStop Pro and Enfocus Switch.
about.closing: Validate your expertise with professional certification recognized across the printing and design industry.
